title: Securitize Plans Stellar Integration for Future Tokenized Assets
why_it_matters: Adding Stellar would give asset managers another regulated issuance and administration route, while the open timetable shows that this is infrastructure planning rather than a live product launch.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INFRASTRUCTURE

Securitize Plans Stellar Integration for Future Tokenized Assets

Securitize plans to add Stellar to its institutional tokenization infrastructure, but has not named supported assets or a completion date.
